```plato

    //==
    // Meshes of the solid sums: the dispatch from each sum into the seed and
    // catalog factories, every result at circumscribed radius one. Each is
    // named after its return type, so a solid converts to its mesh implicitly
    // and a placed instance is that mesh transformed
    // (Convention: see CONVENTIONS.md - Conversions).

    // The five Platonic seeds are already projected onto the unit sphere, so
    // they pass through directly.
    PolygonMesh3D(s: PlatonicSolid): PolygonMesh3D
        => match (s) {
            Tetrahedron => PolygonMesh3D.Tetrahedron;
            Cube => PolygonMesh3D.Cube;
            Octahedron => PolygonMesh3D.Octahedron;
            Dodecahedron => PolygonMesh3D.Dodecahedron;
            Icosahedron => PolygonMesh3D.Icosahedron;
        };
```

    // All thirteen Archimedeans dispatch into the catalog (the base ambo and
    // truncate families in `polyhedra.library.plato`, the expand,
    // bevel and snub families in `polyhedra.library.plato`).
    PolygonMesh3D(s: ArchimedeanSolid): PolygonMesh3D
        => match (s) {
            TruncatedTetrahedron => PolygonMesh3D.TruncatedTetrahedron.ScaledToUnitCircumradius;
